annotations.text:
classroomtools.io redesign — three directions, one design language.

All three use the Cadence design system lifted from the reflow-site and cadence-lms repos: same tokens, three greys, alpha borders, no shadows, mono for values, 13px body.

Every screenshot is the real tool, captured running locally with real classroom-style content.

Directions can be mixed — e.g. A's hero with B's full grid.

A · Showcase
Reflow's marketing anatomy applied to the whole suite: hero with screenshot fan, stats, three featured tools, compact grid, research band, quote, suggest CTA.
Tradeoff: the longest page — the most copy to keep current.

B · Catalog
The tool index is the page: compact hero, filter chips, every tool as an equal card with screenshot. Fastest route from landing to a tool.
Tradeoff: least narrative pull — the research reduces to one strip.

C · Research-led
Leads with the argument, set in the Cadence document (serif) voice. Tools appear grouped under the two instructional models, then a quiet index table.
Tradeoff: tools sit lower on the page; least conventional as marketing.
Tool page pattern — one per tool, shared by every direction (shown: Constellation Board). Chips for status + research model, real screenshot, classroom steps, research connection, related tools.
Dark theme proof — the same tokens as Cadence and Reflow dark. Cadence's own dark dashboard shot drops in unchanged.
